name: ravmem
description: Code-graph search, impact analysis, and persistent cross-session agent memory for this repo, backed by a self-hosted RavMem server over standard MCP.

server_url.title: RavMem server URL
server_url.description: No RavMem server yet? Leave this blank, save, and finish installing. Then run /ravmem:ravmem-setup to install a server and /ravmem:ravmem-configure to set this afterwards. Base URL of your RavMem server, without /mcp and without a trailing slash. The default is http://localhost:7432; change it only if you use another port.

token.title: RavMem API token
token.description: No RavMem server yet? Leave this blank, save, and finish installing. Then run /ravmem:ravmem-setup to install a server and /ravmem:ravmem-configure to set this afterwards. The admin token you put in your RavMem .env (RAVMEM_ADMIN_TOKEN), or a user token from 'ravmem auth create-token'. Needs at least repo:read, branch:read and kg:read; add kg:write to record memory and branch:index for project_sync.

kg_team.title: Memory team
kg_team.description: Which team's memory to read and write (sent as X-KG-Team).

kg_branch.title: Memory branch
kg_branch.description: Which knowledge-graph branch to use (sent as X-KG-Branch).

kg_auto_load.title: Auto-load active tasks into session
kg_auto_load.description: At session start, list the team's open tasks in context. The full task context is loaded on demand with memory_load_context.

kg_auto_record.title: Auto-record decisions and learnings
kg_auto_record.description: Allow the agent to record architectural decisions and learnings to memory as it works.

kg_prune_stale_days.title: KG stale pruning threshold (days)
kg_prune_stale_days.description: Age threshold in days for flagging inactive or uncorroborated learnings during pruning.
